description: This file defines the PatientDashboard widget for a Flutter app, implementing the main patient-specific interface with tab navigation, including home, consultations, medical records, and profile screens. It also includes a quick actions section on the home tab.

classes.name: PatientDashboard
classes.description: Main widget for the patient dashboard page with tab navigation.

classes.name: _PatientDashboardState
classes.description: State class managing the tab navigation and rendering for PatientDashboard.

classes.name: PatientHomeTab
classes.description: Stateless widget displaying the home tab content, including a welcome message and quick action cards.

classes.name: _QuickActionCard
classes.description: Reusable widget representing individual quick action tiles in the home tab.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the PatientDashboard widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the dashboard and home tab.

methods.name: onDestinationSelected
methods.description: Updates the selected index when a navigation destination is tapped.
